name: Acre
summary: Divided diagonally from lower hoist to upper fly: yellow above with a red star in the corner, green below. It is the flag of the short-lived Republic of Acre of 1899.
origin: The design was decreed for the Republic of Acre on 15 July 1899, during the conflict with Bolivia over the rubber-rich territory, and modified in 1921. Law No. 1170 of 22 December 1995 made it the state flag.

symbols.name: Altaneira Star
symbols.meaning: The blood of those who fought for Acre's annexation to Brazil.

facts: Acre was bought from Bolivia by the Treaty of Petrópolis in 1903.
Its green and yellow match the national flag.
clues: Yellow over green, divided diagonally, with a red star.
The flag of a short-lived rubber-boom republic.
Its territory was bought from Bolivia.
